messages:
Marta Cole: Sales closed with Helios Therapeutics (enterprise). Passing to CS for onboarding and to Eng for private deployment + SSO/VPC.

Marta Cole: Contract snapshot:
```
account: Helios Therapeutics
contact: kate@heliostx.com (Head of IT)
term: 12 months, committed
needs: Dedicated capacity (3x A100 equiv), VPC peering, SAML (Okta), audit logging to customer SIEM
pilot window: target 2025-03-15 to 2025-03-29
```

Devon Price: I'll take CS lead. Immediate asks from Sales: IdP metadata, network CIDRs, customer security contact, and sample payloads for perf.

Liam O'Connor: @infra-bot please create ENG ticket for Helios private deploy + SSO (sizing + peering + SIEM).

infra-bot: Created ENG-9133: "Helios private deploy + SSO/Peering". Owners: eng-runtime, eng-network. Link: https://internal/ENG-9133

Sana Iqbal: I'll own runbook and support playbook. Plan: 30m kickoff, 1h tech deep dive, enablement doc and triage matrix.

Devon Price: Proposed milestones:
- Sales to provide IdP + CIDRs by 2025-02-20
- Kickoff by 2025-02-25
- ENG sizing PR in ENG-9133 by 2025-03-01
- Staging peering + SSO by 2025-03-10
- Pilot start 2025-03-15

Marta Cole: Kate says security reviews may take 10 business days. Flagging timeline risk; recommend weekly updates until SSO is green.

Liam O'Connor: I'll provision a small staging pool after sample payloads are attached to ENG-9133. Devon, please collect token sizes and concurrency patterns.

Sana Iqbal: I'll add a short post-kickoff feedback survey and a checklist for CS handoff to Support. Also adding common SSO troubleshooting steps.

Devon Price: Risk notes: renewal risk low (committed), but execution risk medium until peering completed. If approvals slip > 2 weeks, escalate to Sales Ops.

Marta Cole: Intro email to Kate sent with CC to Devon and Sana. Kate acknowledged and will start gathering IdP metadata.

Devon Price: Next steps: 1) Sales attach IdP + CIDRs to ENG-9133. 2) Devon schedule kickoff. 3) Liam post initial sizing when payloads available. 4) Sana draft runbook and support playbook.

infra-bot: ENG-9133 updated with owners and priority HIGH.
